The '''energy torpedo launcher''' was a [[Missile launcher/Legends|projectile launcher]] that fired [[Energy torpedo/Legends|energy torpedoes]]. The [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|''Vulture''-class starfighter]] were equipped with two energy torpedo launchers.<ref name="RPG-Core" />
